headline: Weak Purchasing Power, OJK Warns Banks Not to Disburse Credit Carelessly
summary: The OJK is encouraging banks to expand credit in a balanced way, taking into account borrowers' ability to repay. The call comes as purchasing power weakens.
why: Lending standards set by the financial regulator affect loan growth and credit quality, which matter for bank earnings and risk.
original_headline: Daya Beli Seret, OJK Peringatkan Bank Jangan Asal Kucurkan Kredit
